units.name: Introduction
units.assessment: Can you explain why von Willebrand disease is at once the most common inherited bleeding disorder and one of the most under-recognised, and name the separate properties of von Willebrand factor that any diagnostic workup has to measure independently?

lesson.title: von Willebrand Disease, Platelet Dysfunction, and Other Mucocutaneous IBDs
lesson.why: A full clinician-to-clinician session that frames VWD alongside the other mucocutaneous bleeding disorders it must be distinguished from, which is exactly the orientation this opening section provides.

units.name: Incidence and pathophysiology
units.assessment: Can you trace von Willebrand factor from endothelial synthesis through multimer assembly, Weibel-Palade body storage, secretion and ADAMTS13 cleavage, and then say which of those steps is disturbed in each VWD subtype?

lesson.title: Basics of von Willebrand Disease (VWD)
lesson.why: The National Bleeding Disorders Foundation basics session covers prevalence and the biology of VWF in one pass, which maps onto this section's incidence-plus-pathophysiology scope.

drills.title: VON WILLEBRAND FACTOR: ITS ROLE IN AND BEYOND HEMOSTATIS

units.name: Bleeding phenotype
units.assessment: Given a patient with recurrent epistaxis and heavy menstrual bleeding, can you say how a structured bleeding assessment tool shifts your pretest probability of VWD, and which symptoms should point you instead towards a platelet function defect?

lesson.title: ERN-EuroBloodNet Thursdays Webinars: Von Willebrand factor and von Willebrand disease in ageing
lesson.why: A European reference network webinar on VWF across the lifespan, the best available treatment of how the VWD bleeding phenotype declares itself and then changes with age.

drills.name: Low VWF and heavy menstrual bleeding in adolescents
drills.title: Whole 1 Exome Analysis of Adolescents with Low VWF and Heavy Menstrual Bleeding

drills.name: Menstrual bleeding as the dominant phenotype
drills.title: Von Willebrand Disease (VWD): The Realities of Your Period

units.name: VWD type 1
units.assessment: Can you state the von Willebrand factor level that separates type 1 VWD from so-called low VWF, and explain how an accelerated-clearance variant such as type 1C changes both the desmopressin trial and the durability of the response?

lesson.title: Unpacking von Willebrand disease: Dr. Paula James talks diagnosis & pre-procedure prophylaxis
lesson.channel: MDedge: news and insights for busy physicians
lesson.why: Paula James, one of the authors of the current VWD guidelines, walks through type 1 diagnosis and pre-procedure prophylaxis in the compact form this section needs.

drills.title: Interpreting tests for von Willebrand disease (VWD)

drills.name: Laboratory diagnosis from the bench side
drills.title: Hematopathology lecture 1: Von Willebrand Disease. Dr. Daniel Sabath

units.name: VWD type 2
units.assessment: Can you separate types 2A, 2B, 2M and 2N using the activity-to-antigen ratio, low-dose ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation, multimer analysis and the factor VIII level, and say which of those subtypes makes desmopressin the wrong drug?

lesson.title: Presentation #2: Case 2 - von Willebrand Disease, Type 2B (Margaret Ragni, MD, MPH)
lesson.channel: Foundation for Women & Girls With Blood Disorders
lesson.why: A worked type 2B case from Margaret Ragni that shows precisely how the qualitative subtypes are teased apart and why 2B behaves differently from the rest.

drills.name: When the VWD panel does not fit a subtype
drills.title: Challenging Scenarios of Diagnosing von Willebrand Disease

drills.name: Veronica Flood on what the guidelines changed
drills.title: Veronica Flood - VWD Guidelines

units.name: VWD type 3
units.assessment: Can you explain why type 3 VWD produces a hemophilia-like picture with joint and muscle bleeding, and describe how alloantibodies against von Willebrand factor change replacement therapy and raise the risk of anaphylaxis?

lesson.title: Personalizing Care of von Willebrand Disease With Current and Emerging Management Strategies
lesson.why: The closest fit available: a management-focused session covering the severe end of the VWD spectrum, including recombinant VWF and prophylaxis, which is where type 3 sits.

units.name: Genetic testing
units.assessment: Can you name the clinical situations in which sequencing the VWF gene adds something phenotypic testing cannot give you, and say which subtype diagnoses genotyping is able to confirm or overturn?

lesson.title: Archive: Genetic Modifiers in Von Willebrand Factor parameters
lesson.why: A university lecture on the genetic determinants of VWF levels, which explains why genotype and phenotype diverge and therefore when sequencing is worth ordering.

drills.name: Where genetic testing fits in hematology generally
drills.title: Guiding Hematologic Care with Genetic Testing

units.name: Acquired von Willebrand syndrome
units.assessment: Can you list the settings that strip high-molecular-weight VWF multimers - aortic stenosis, ventricular assist devices and ECMO, myeloproliferative neoplasms with extreme thrombocytosis, and lymphoproliferative disorders - and say how treating the underlying condition differs from replacement or IVIG?

lesson.title: Laboratory Testing of von Willebrand Disease and Acquired von Willebrand Syndrome
lesson.why: Mayo Clinic Laboratories walks through the assays that separate acquired von Willebrand syndrome from inherited VWD, which is the diagnostic problem this section is about.

units.name: Treatment
units.assessment: Can you decide when desmopressin, an antifibrinolytic, a plasma-derived VWF-factor VIII concentrate or recombinant VWF is the correct choice, and state the trough levels and the number of days of cover to target around major surgery?

lesson.title: The NEW VWD Guidelines
lesson.why: A guideline-focused session on the current VWD recommendations, where the treatment thresholds and the desmopressin-versus-concentrate decision are actually set out.

units.name: Gaps in knowledge
units.assessment: Can you name the questions VWD care has not settled - where to draw the diagnostic threshold, who benefits from long-term prophylaxis, how women are served, and why access lags behind hemophilia - and say what kind of evidence would resolve each of them?

lesson.title: Clotting the Gaps in VWD Care
lesson.why: A CME session built explicitly around the unmet needs and care gaps in VWD, which is the subject of this closing section.
